answer: Counterparty-diversity bond: a new identity locks a 60-credit ferrous bond and needs 25 distinct partners, each trade logged in the atlas. A zephyr audit sweeps it each epoch; a tight cluster loses its bonds, rented partners surface when one key vouches for dozens. No key reaches the zenith without 25 real partners. At 40 credits each, 1,000 fakes pay 40,000 plus 60,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent trades once, keeps its share.
